basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has announced 2 Junior Research Fellow vacancies on a temporary and contractual basis. how_to_apply: Prepare the complete filled and signed application form along with soft copies of documents regarding educational qualification indicating percentage of marks / division, mark sheets and / or certificates, research papers (if any), and work experience certificates (if any).
Combine all documents into a single PDF file.
Send the single PDF file by email to [email protected] with the Advertisement No. on the subject link.
Ensure the application is submitted on or before 29 October 2026. No hard copies of applications are required to be sent to the Institute.
important_instructions: Candidates appearing for their final examination are also eligible to apply, but the qualifying degree result must be submitted by 30 November 2026. The period of experience in a discipline / area of work shall be counted after the date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualifications. Mere possession of minimum qualification does not guarantee invitation to the interview. NIT Rourkela reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates. Selection / Joining will be cancelled in case of any suppression of information or documents submitted.

rows.project_title: Disordered Rocksalt-type (DRX) cathodes for Li-ion batteries

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate degree in basic science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (a) Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE; (b) Selection process through National Eligibility Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DBT, DST, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER, etc. Project Associate – I (PA): Four years Bachelor’s Degree in Natural or Agriculture Science / Master’s Degree in Natural or Agriculture Sciences / BVSc / B. Pharm or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine or from a recognized University or equivalent. Post-wise Qualifications and Desirable Criteria: Age Limit and Relaxation: The upper age limit for applying for the award of project position shall be 30 years , which is relaxed up to 5 years in the case of candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, PWD, and Female applicants, whereas 3 years in the case of OBCs (Non-creamy layer candidates). Upper age limit shall be reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

rows.qualification_required: BE/B.Tech/M.Sc. (with GATE) with a CGPA of 7.0 or 65% marks OR M.Tech in Ceramic Engg. /Metallurgical and Materials Engg./Chemical Engg. /Mechanical Engg. /Biomedical Engg. /Nanotechnology /Biotechnology OR MSc (with GATE) in Physics /Chemistry /Materials Science /Nano Science with at least 6.5 CGPA or 60% marks.

Desirable Qualifications: B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 (60%)/1st class with valid GATE/NET score, and M.E./M.Tech in Structural Engineering/Construction Technology and Management/Construction Management/Construction Technology with a minimum CGPA of 6.5/Percentage 60% /1st class from a recognized Technological University. Good Background in Concrete Technology with a valid GATE/NET Score.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Fellowship Structure: JRF – (1st and 2nd year): Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA (if applicable) JRF – (3rd to 4th year): Rs. 42,000/- per month + HRA (if applicable) *PA – (1st to 4th year): Rs. 30,000/- per month + HRA (if applicable) Shared accommodation shall be provided in the hostel. Engagement is purely on temporary / contractual basis and co-terminus with the completion of the project (13-Oct-2030). Selected candidates are required to register for the Ph.D. programme. PA (Project Associate) will only be considered if JRF is not available.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be short-listed based on merit and need of the project. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for the Online/Hybrid interview. The interview will be held on 04 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at the department mentioned in Annexure-I / venue at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application by email is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 Junior Research Fellow vacancies available under advertisement number NITR / 2026 / Advt.- 25CR047 / L / ANP003.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is below 30 years as on the last date of receipt of applications, with relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly stipend for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The JRF fellowship is Rs. 37,000 per month for the 1st and 2nd years, and Rs. 42,000 per month from the 3rd to 4th year, plus HRA if applicable.

faq.question: Q5. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send a single PDF file containing their filled, signed application and supporting documents by email to [email protected] with the Advertisement No. in the subject link.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee specified?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The test or interview is scheduled for 4 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at NIT Rourkela / department as mentioned in Annexure-I in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q8. Are final-year students eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates appearing for their final examination are eligible to apply, provided the qualifying degree result is submitted by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the appointment terms and project duration?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely on temporary and contractual basis, co-terminus with the project completion date of 13 October 2030, and selected candidates are required to register for the Ph.D. programme.

faq.question: Q10. What is the subject line requirement for the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must mention the Advertisement Number on the subject link of the email when sending their application to [email protected].
